meta.name: hunt-aspnet
meta.description: Hunt ASP.NET-specific surface — ViewState deserialization (signed-only vs encrypted), machineKey recovery, dual-parser MAC-bypass anti-pattern, request-validator bypass, trace.axd/elmah.axd disclosure, load-balanced ViewState cross-node failures, SafeControl enumeration via reflection, customErrors mode=Off stack-trace leaks, classic Webforms .aspx/.asmx/.svc surface. Built for ASP.NET Webforms + WCF + SharePoint farms.

copy.tagline: 检测ASP.NET应用的安全漏洞与配置弱点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要评估ASP.NET Webforms或SharePoint应用的安全性。
copy.tagline_en: Detect security vulnerabilities and configuration weaknesses in ASP.NET applications
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to assess the security of ASP.NET Webforms or SharePoint applications.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会专门扫描 ASP.NET Webforms、WCF 和 SharePoint 应用的安全漏洞，例如 ViewState 反序列化、machineKey 泄露、trace.axd 暴露等。
howto.when: 当用户要求检查 ASP.NET 网站安全，或提到 ViewState、machineKey、trace.axd 等关键词时触发。

say.text: 检查这个 ASP.NET 网站是否有 ViewState 反序列化漏洞。
扫描 trace.axd 和 elmah.axd 是否可匿名访问。
say.note: Claude 会尝试访问这些路径并报告结果。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will specifically scan ASP.NET Webforms, WCF, and SharePoint applications for security vulnerabilities such as ViewState deserialization, machineKey disclosure, trace.axd exposure, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to check ASP.NET website security or mentions keywords like ViewState, machineKey, trace.axd.

say_en.text: Check this ASP.NET site for ViewState deserialization vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze ViewState encryption status and MAC validation.

say_en.text: Scan for anonymous access to trace.axd and elmah.axd.
say_en.note: Claude will attempt to access these paths and report results.
